reviews.text: Highly recommend we went in today last minute to put our sick 16 year old dog down. It was a tough decision however Maru showed us extreme compassion and treated us with the utmost professionalism during this unexpected situation. Prices were reasonable and I cannot express how grateful I am for everything. Every staff member was highly helpful as well as explaining every step of the process. I want to thank everyone for what you do on a daily basis.

Dr Romeo and her staff are wonderful.  They make it easy to communicate via text and with pictures/video so I don’t have to drag my 15 yr old Leo in every single time he needs something.   They are kind, work with your budget and even call to follow up and see how things are the next day.  I highly recommend taking your pet to CityVet in Southtown.
Everyone, including Dr. Romeo, was pleasant and helpful. We will definitely go back to CityVet!

Big shout out to Dr. Romeo and her staff! I’ve been taking my two cats there for a couple years now. My cat, Puka, is an exceptionally questionable specimen that loves to eat non-food items. When he required an urgent surgery to remove a foreign obstruction, Dr. Romeo was able to fit him in her schedule that same day. It was amazing, it was personable, and it’s why I’ll always recommend this location specifically.

The staff remembers your pets’ names and quirky little mannerisms. It truly blows any and every other vet experience I’ve had out of the water.
Dr Romeo is amazing! She gives great care to both our pups.
Thank you, Tascha, for your review! We appreciate your support!
Thank you, Bob, for taking the time to leave a review. We appreciate your feedback!

The entire staff is truly amazing and made me feel comfortable as well as my cat.
Incredible experience so incredibly friendly and comfortable. I am so grateful that I found them.
Amazing customer service. I’m very satisfied with my Little Shinzu visit today thank you.
Oreo’s check-up went great! Thank you Dr. Romeo!
